children: Greece's economy expanded 1.9% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026 on a seasonally adjusted basis, slowing from 2.0% growth in the previous quarter, according to provisional data from the country's statistics agency ELSTAT on Monday.
On a quarterly basis, gross domestic product rose 0.3% in April-June after a 0.2% increase in the first quarter.
Total final consumption expenditure rose 1.3% from the second quarter of 2025, up from 0.9% in January-March 2026.
Exports of goods and services were up 2.2% year-on-year, while imports increased 3.7%.
Gross fixed capital formation, which measures investment in long-term assets such as buildings and infrastructure, increased 6.1% year-on-year, down from 12.1% in the previous quarter.
